from scipy.optimize import minimize
def fitp(q,extra=True):
    p=q[0]; a,w=q[1],q[2]
    cols=[np.ones(len(t)),x**p,v,1/v,t/v]
    if extra: cols+= [x]
    Xw=np.column_stack(cols+[np.exp(-a*t)*np.cos(w*t),np.exp(-a*t)*np.sin(w*t)])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Xw,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dv_dt-Xw@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt),c
